attestations.text: CHANG Hai-p'êng 張海鵬 (T. 若雲, H. 子瑜, 照曠主人), Mar. 28, 1755–1816, Aug. 3, bibliophile and editor, was a native of Ch'ang-shu, Kiangsu. His family is said to have been descended from a younger brother of Chang Chiu-ling 張九齡 (T. 子壽, 678–740), a learned scholar as well as an upright official of the T'ang dynasty.
